mapper.sql: SELECT r.REQUEST_ID, r.TITLE, r.CONTENT, r.SERVICE_ADDRESS, r.STATUS_CODE, r.CREATED_AT, sc.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME, cc.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, u.NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, u.PHONE AS CUSTOMER_PHONE, e.ESTIMATE_ID, e.ESTIMATED_PRICE, e.ESTIMATED_DURATION, e.CONTENT AS ESTIMATE_CONTENT FROM ESTIMATES e JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REQUEST_ID = e.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = r.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = r.CATEGORY_CODE LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE sc ON sc.CODE_ID = r.STATUS_CODE WHERE e.FIXER_NO = #{fixerNo} AND e.STATUS = 'SELECTED'
mapper.select:
AND r.STATUS_CODE = #{statusCode}
ORDER BY CASE r.STATUS_CODE WHEN 'REQ_03' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.REQUEST_ID DESC
